# Thirty1 Labs

## Creator
- Owner name: Noah Novak
- Website: https://thirty1labs.com/
- Purpose: Just to develop apps for fun. The owner is a student developer, trying to share his coding skills with the world.

## Products and apps
- NovaWeather: A highly customizable mobile weather app.

## About the site
- This website is the public home for Thirty1 Labs.
- It is used to share projects, product information, documentation, and related resources.
- Content is intended for public discovery and general information.
- Note about 31L (Thirty1 Labs): Thirty1 Labs is NOT a registered U.S. corporation. It is only an "alias", and is just for fun.
